page.overview:
What is Baigujing?

The was a shapeshifting demoness who preyed on travellers on White Tiger Ridge.

In her true form, the White Bone Demon resembled a skeleton with an enlarged spine that had "白骨夫人" written down it.

When Tang Sanzang came to White Tiger Ridge, she plotted to kill him, as eating his corpse would make her immortal. She disguised herself as a beautiful young woman carrying vegetarian food, but Sun Wukong saw through her disguise. Before he struck her, she used a spell to replace herself with a realistic-looking corpse.

She next appeared in the form of the young woman's mother, but Sun Wukong once again sussed her out and she used the same spell to escape. She appeared one final time as the young woman's father, but this time Sun Wukong had the local mountain gods bind her before killing her.
